method: FastAPI TestClient against actual /api/chat/suggestions route with configured Ollama HTTP calls; no browser; Laya is not used by the suggestion endpoint

suggestions: What is the price range of the Samsung Galaxy A06?
Is the Samsung Galaxy A16 5G available in Light Green?

notes: The initial Ollama result failed an existing unsupported-number check; it was not returned or cached.
One fresh generation was requested and validated successfully. The returned values and named models occur in the corresponding listing rows.
Association validation added about 1.7 ms across both attempts. The request took about 8.0 seconds because validation failure incurred a second Ollama generation.
This is API evidence only and does not certify rendered popup behavior or browser timing.
